contracts: LP counter is selected at the strict cold epoch, not first MMIO. Actual DIG DCAP128 observation enables136kHz at its real service boundary; unknown prefix is never backfilled.

Old-rate ticks integrate before source updates. None freezes; unknown-source UPDATE rejects before state mutation. UPDATE27 captures actual counter48 and shifts previous capture without any invented VALID or counter-enable bit.
Clock refresh services joint watchdogs first, then publishes slow source only with no pending reset. LP timer MMIO also guards global pending reset before internal advancement.

CPU/Core retain LP counter/phase/captures; LP/System clears at actual watchdog_reset_at then catches up. The late300M service/130M TG/228M SWD regression captures40800ticks after the applied LP reset. Chip withdraws its analog source.
Raw/SRAM mode deselects LP timing. No alarm/IRQ/sleep/DATE-as-counter-gate interface is claimed.
limits: Virtual epoch0, nominal240MHz scheduler and bounded RCslow/DCAP profile; no absolute silicon uptime or physical oscillator accuracy.

Report counter_at is the lazy last integration point, not necessarily the current Bus cycle. Only watchdog/LP reset ordering described here is timestamped; whole-machine asynchronous reset accuracy is not claimed.
Original application entry/startup is verified, but app_main, full8MiB PSRAM test, LCD/buttons/TF/Wi-Fi remain pending. First real gap is app PMU configuration.
